headline: Apply to the SDOH ART Fellowship
intro: Applications are submitted through an online form (Microsoft Forms). Review the items below before you start.

checklist.label: Mailing address
checklist.detail: Street, city, state, and ZIP code.

checklist.label: Education
checklist.detail: Degree, institution, and years completed or to be completed.

checklist.label: Research experience
checklist.detail: Past research experience and any ongoing research programs.

checklist.label: Research statement (about 500 words)
checklist.detail: Describe your research interests and how this training would strengthen your research on non-biological influences on health (social, cultural, environmental, political). State whether you hope to use ART training primarily to: (1) identify or address gaps in understanding how non-biological influences affect your outcomes of interest, (2) target non-biological negative influences to improve health outcomes, or (3) target non-biological positive influences to maintain the health of individuals, communities, and/or societies.

referencesNote: Send all reference letters to EmoryArt@emory.edu. Each letter must include your name at the top.
eligibility: Pre- and postdoctoral fellows and early-career faculty whose research engages non-biological (social, cultural, environmental, and political) influences on health. Letters of support from research mentors and institutional leadership are required.

fields.name: researchArea
fields.label: Research area / SDOH topic of interest

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Statement of research interest
fields.help: Briefly describe your research and how the fellowship fits your goals.

fields.name: references
fields.label: Reference letters or referee contacts
fields.help: List referees with email, or note that letters will be sent separately. Applications without references are considered incomplete.

fields.name: hearAbout
fields.label: How did you hear about the program?

fields.name: consent
fields.label: I confirm the information provided is accurate.
